metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing all decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy:
   - Collection: Sentinel-5P tropospheric NO2 data (TROPOMI instrument)
   - Date ranges: January 1-20, 2020 and February 10-25, 2020
   - Location: Beijing (approximately 39.9042°N, 116.4074°E)
   
2. Masking strategy:
   - NO2 data may have QA flags; filter by QA value threshold (typically >0.75)
   - No cloud masking needed for TROPOMI as it's above clouds
   
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null/Error (C3):
   - Valid decrease: Both periods have valid data, Feb mean < Jan mean → A
   - Valid increase or no change: Both periods have valid data, Feb mean ≥ Jan mean → B
   - No data in either period → C1
   - Valid data exists but no valid pixels after QA filtering → C2
   - Calculation returns NaN or invalid range (NO2 should be 0-1e16 mol/m²) → C3
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Beijing coordinates
  const beijing = ee.Geometry.Point([116.4074, 39.9042]);
  const bufferGeom = beijing.buffer(50000); // ~50km buffer for regional analysis
  
  // Date ranges
  const jan_start = '2020-01-01';
  const jan_end = '2020-01-20';
  const feb_start = '2020-02-10';
  const feb_end = '2020-02-25';
  
  // Load Sentinel-5P NO2 data
  const s5p = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_L3_NO2');
  
  // January 2020 collection
  let jan_col = s5p.filterDate(jan_start, jan_end)
    .filterBounds(bufferGeom)
    .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density');
  
  let jan_size = jan_col.size().getInfo();
  console.log(`January Images: ${jan_size}`);
  
  // February 2020 collection
  let feb_col = s5p.filterDate(feb_start, feb_end)
    .filterBounds(bufferGeom)
    .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density');
  
  let feb_size = feb_col.size().getInfo();
  console.log(`February Images: ${feb_size}`);
  
  // Check for empty collections
  if (jan_size === 0 || feb_size === 0) {
    console.log('No data for one or both periods.');
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }
  
  // Apply QA filtering and calculate mean for January
  let jan_filtered = jan_col.map(img => {
    let qa = img.select('qa_value');
    return img.updateMask(qa.gte(0.75));
  });
  
  let jan_mean_result = jan_filtered.mean().reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: bufferGeom,
    scale: 3000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo();
  
  let jan_count = jan_filtered.mean().reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: bufferGeom,
    scale: 3000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo();
  
  console.log(`Jan Mean: ${jan_mean_result}, Pixels: ${jan_count}`);
  
  // Apply QA filtering and calculate mean for February
  let feb_filtered = feb_col.map(img => {
    let qa = img.select('qa_value');
    return img.updateMask(qa.gte(0.75));
  });
  
  let feb_mean_result = feb_filtered.mean().reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: bufferGeom,
    scale: 3000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo();
  
  let feb_count = feb_filtered.mean().reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: bufferGeom,
    scale: 3000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo();
  
  console.log(`Feb Mean: ${feb_mean_result}, Pixels: ${feb_count}`);
  
  // Validate results
  if (jan_count === 0 || feb_count === 0) {
    console.log('No valid pixels after QA filtering.');
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }
  
  if (jan_mean_result === null || feb_mean_result === null || 
      isNaN(jan_mean_result) || isNaN(feb_mean_result)) {
    console.log('Calculation failed: NaN or null values.');
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }
  
  // Check if values are in reasonable range (mol/m²)
  if (jan_mean_result < 0 || feb_mean_result < 0 || 
      jan_mean_result > 1e16 || feb_mean_result > 1e16) {
    console.log('Invalid NO2 values detected.');
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }
  
  console.log(`Comparison: Jan=${jan_mean_result.toExponential(2)}, Feb=${feb_mean_result.toExponential(2)}`);
  
  // Determine if decrease occurred
  if (feb_mean_result < jan_mean_result) {
    console.log('A');
  } else {
    console.log('B');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
